Title: Account Executive
Notes: Requester: submits contracts to the playbook and sends the escalation requests. No approval authority

Title: Contracts Manager
Notes: Record custodian: receives every final approval and stores the approval record, the evidence and the signed contract together. Also approves pre-approved positions and first-step legal deviations

Title: Deal Desk Manager
Notes: Before signature, checks the final contract against the approvals. Also approves first-step commercial deviations

Title: Chief Information Security Officer
Notes: Appears at several levels, usually jointly

Title: General Counsel
Notes: Owns this matrix; receives anything the matrix does not cover

Title: Chief Executive Officer
Notes: Final authority where the matrix names CEO
